properties.label: Target Form
properties.description:
Select the target Joget form where Microsoft Calendar data will be created or updated.

Important:
• The selected form must be the current form where this binder is configured.
• All field mappings below will refer to columns of this form only.
• Changing the form will reset all mapped fields.

properties.label: Basic Event Fields
properties.description:
Map basic fields used to create or update the Microsoft calendar event.

Guidelines:
• Subject is mandatory and represents the event title in Microsoft Calendar.
• Location is optional and may be overridden automatically when Teams meeting is enabled.
• Description supports rich text and will be stored as the event body.

Input:
• All fields must be text-based columns.

properties.label: Date & Time Mapping
properties.description:
Configure date and time fields used to calculate event start and end time.

All Day Events:
• Use From Date and To Date fields only.
• Format must be yyyy-MM-dd.

Timed Events:
• Format must be yyyy-MM-dd.
• Use From Date Time and To Date Time fields.
• These fields are ignored for all-day events.

Important:
• Date and Date-Time fields must be mapped separately.
• Do not reuse the same field for both modes.

properties.label: Flags & Toggles
properties.description:
Boolean flags that control event behavior in Microsoft Calendar.

Requirements:
• Fields must be Boolean (true/false).
• Values are evaluated case-insensitively.

Behavior:
• All Day controls whether date or date-time fields are used.
• Enable Teams Meeting automatically converts the event to an online meeting.
• Is Recurring determines whether recurrence rules are applied.

properties.label: Participants Mapping
properties.description:
Map participants who will be added to the calendar event.

Internal Participants:
• Must contain Joget user email addresses only.
• System will validate these against Joget users.

External Participants:
• Used for non-Joget users.
• Must contain valid email addresses only.

Input Format:
• Multi-select field OR text field with values separated by ;
• Example: user1@company.com;user2@company.com
• Usernames are NOT supported, emails only.

properties.label: Recurrence Mapping
properties.description:
Fields required to construct recurring Microsoft calendar events.

Recurrence Type:
• Must be a dropdown/select box.
• Supported values:
  • daily
  • weekly
  • monthly
  • yearly

Recurrence Interval:
• Must be a numeric field.
• Example: 1 (every week), 2 (every 2 weeks).

Recurrence Days (Weekly):
• Multi-select or checkbox field.
• Values must be lowercase and separated by ;.
• Example: monday;wednesday;friday

Recurrence End Date:
• Required for recurring events.
• Format must be yyyy-MM-dd only.

properties.label: Extended Property (Single Value)
properties.description:
Configure a Microsoft Graph single-value extended property.

Usage:
• Used to store application-specific identifiers (e.g. Matter ID).
• Helps uniquely identify and filter events in Microsoft Calendar.

GUID & ID Format:
• GUID must be a valid UUID format.
• Example: 8F6C2F2A-4D4E-4C7C-A0E2-1F6E6C2A9C11
• Property Name must be a single identifier (no spaces, no separators).
• Example: matterId

Important Warning:
• The extended property value must be a single value.
• Do NOT use separators such as ;, ,, or |.
• Only one value will be stored and queried in Microsoft Graph.

Technical Notes:
• GUID and Name together define the extended property ID in Microsoft Graph.
• The mapped form field stores the value as plain text.

properties.label: Microsoft Metadata
properties.description:
Additional Microsoft Graph metadata fields stored in Joget for reference.

Purpose:
• These fields do not affect event creation.
• Used for tracking, linking, and reporting.

Stored Values:
• Organizer email address
• Series Master ID (for recurring events)
• Microsoft Event URL
• Teams Meeting join URL

Note:
• All fields should be text-based.
• Values are populated automatically from Microsoft Graph responses.
